name: PageLayout
description: `PageLayout` composes page headers, navigation panes or sidebars, content, and footers into a responsive layout.

props.name: columnGap
props.description: Horizontal spacing between the sidebar, content, and pane.

props.name: containerWidth
props.description: Maximum width of the centered content column.

props.name: footer
props.description: Supplies the footer region. Takes precedence over a matching `PageLayout.Footer` child.

props.name: header
props.description: Supplies the header region. Takes precedence over a matching `PageLayout.Header` child.

props.name: padding
props.description: Spacing between the page container's outer edges and the viewport.

props.name: rowGap
props.description: Vertical spacing between the header, content, and footer.

props.name: sidebar
props.description: Supplies the sidebar region. Takes precedence over a matching `PageLayout.Sidebar` child.

props.name: divider
props.description: Divider drawn below the header. Accepts a responsive object to vary it per viewport.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the header. Accepts a responsive object to hide it only at some viewports.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing of the header region.

props.name: as
props.description: Element to render.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the content. Accepts a responsive object to hide it only at some viewports.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing of the content region.

props.name: width
props.description: Maximum width of the content column.

props.name: currentWidth
props.description: Controls the pane width in pixels. Supply it with `onResizeEnd` to own the width yourself.

props.name: divider
props.description: Divider drawn between the pane and the content. Accepts a responsive object to vary it per viewport.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the pane. Accepts a responsive object to hide it only at some viewports.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Smallest width in pixels the pane may be resized to.

props.name: offsetHeader
props.description: Distance a sticky pane is offset from the top, to clear a fixed header above it.

props.name: onResizeEnd
props.description: Called with the new width when a resize finishes.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing of the pane.

props.name: position
props.description: Which side of the content the pane sits on. Accepts a responsive object to move it per viewport.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Lets the user drag the pane's edge to resize it.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keeps the pane in view as the content scrolls.

props.name: width
props.description: Pane width, either a named size or a custom min/default/max triple.

props.name: widthStorageKey
props.description: Key under which a resized width is persisted, so the pane reopens at the user's chosen size.

props.name: currentWidth
props.description: Controls the pane width in pixels. Supply it with `onResizeEnd` to own the width yourself.

props.name: divider
props.description: Divider drawn between the pane and the content. Accepts a responsive object to vary it per viewport.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the pane. Accepts a responsive object to hide it only at some viewports.

props.name: minWidth
props.description: Smallest width in pixels the pane may be resized to.

props.name: onResizeEnd
props.description: Called with the new width when a resize finishes.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing of the pane.

props.name: position
props.description: Which side of the content the pane sits on. Accepts a responsive object to move it per viewport.

props.name: resizable
props.description: Lets the user drag the pane's edge to resize it.

props.name: responsiveVariant
props.description: How the sidebar behaves on narrow viewports: inline by default, or as a fullscreen overlay.

props.name: sticky
props.description: Keeps the pane in view as the content scrolls.

props.name: width
props.description: Pane width, either a named size or a custom min/default/max triple.

props.name: widthStorageKey
props.description: Key under which a resized width is persisted, so the pane reopens at the user's chosen size.

props.name: divider
props.description: Divider drawn above the footer. Accepts a responsive object to vary it per viewport.

props.name: hidden
props.description: Hides the footer. Accepts a responsive object to hide it only at some viewports.

props.name: padding
props.description: Inner spacing of the footer region.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name for the separator, describing what it resizes.

props.name: aria-labelledby
props.description: Id of an element naming the separator, as an alternative to `aria-label`.

props.name: aria-valuemax
props.description: Largest width the separator can be dragged to, announced by assistive technology.

props.name: aria-valuemin
props.description: Smallest width the separator can be dragged to, announced by assistive technology.

props.name: aria-valuenow
props.description: Current width of the pane, announced by assistive technology.

props.name: formatValueText
props.description: Turns the current width into the text announced while resizing.

props.name: handleRef
props.description: Ref to the drag handle element, so the pane can measure and focus it.

props.name: onDoubleClick
props.description: Called when the handle is double-clicked, conventionally to reset the pane to its default width.

props.name: onDrag
props.description:
Called as the handle moves. A pointer drag passes the pointer's horizontal position, at most once per frame; an
arrow key passes a signed step in pixels and sets `isKeyboard`.

props.name: onDragEnd
props.description: Called when a drag ends, or when an arrow key that moved the handle is released.

props.name: onDragStart
props.description: Called when a pointer starts dragging the handle, with the pointer's horizontal position.
